description: Big kinetic title: characters rise out of per-word masks, an accent bar wipes in, the subtitle tracks in; exits upward. Transparent background (optional scrim).

params.title: Main title text (wraps to max 2 lines, auto-fit)
params.subtitle: Smaller line under the accent bar (optional)
params.eyebrow: Tiny pill label above the title, e.g. 'EPISODE 4' (optional)
params.highlight: Comma-separated words of the title to paint in the accent colour (optional)
params.font: Font family (bundled: Inter, Montserrat, Outfit, Poppins, Archivo Black, Oswald, League Gothic, Playfair Display...), default Inter
params.background: Solid background used only for opaque .mp4 output, default #0B0B10
